bookings.problemDescription: Vehicle clicks when I turn the key, headlights are very dim, engine is not cranking at all.
bookings.customerAddress: Near Bandra Reclamation Promenade, Bandra West, Mumbai

timeline.note: Equipped Jump Starter, Battery Tester, and Multimeter
Mechanic en route, estimated arrival in 6 mins

possibleCauses: Depleted battery charge due to accessory left running or low voltage
Corroded battery terminals preventing high current crank
Alternator diode fault failing to recharge while driving
aiDiagnosis.recommendedService: Jump Start & Battery Health Diagnostic Test
safeChecks: Shift transmission into Park (P) or Neutral (N) with handbrake engaged.
Do not continuously crank the starter motor to avoid burning out the starter solenoid.
Keep hazard lights blinking for roadside safety.
aiDiagnosis.safetyWarning: Do not smoke or use open flames near the vehicle battery; lead-acid cells can release flammable hydrogen gas.
aiDiagnosis.disclaimer: AI-generated assessment — mechanic will conduct live multimeter voltage and cold-crank amp verification.

bookings.problemDescription: Right rear tyre suddenly lost all air pressure after crossing a pothole on JVLR. TPMS shows 0 PSI.
bookings.customerAddress: JVLR near Powai Lake Flyover, Mumbai

timeline.note: Tubeless puncture repair and sidewall inspection

possibleCauses: Rim pinch resulting from sharp pothole impact
aiDiagnosis.recommendedService: Tubeless Strip Plug Repair & High-Volume Re-inflation
safeChecks: Ensure car is on flat asphalt away from traffic before jacking.
aiDiagnosis.disclaimer: AI-generated assessment — mechanic will check sidewall for internal structural tears.

bookings.mechanicDiagnosisNotes: Found 2-inch steel construction screw lodged into main tread channel. Sidewall intact.
bookings.workPerformed: Extracted screw, reamed puncture hole, installed vulcanized rubber strip plug, inflated to 33 PSI.

additionalCharges.description: High-pressure valve stem replacement (worn out rubber seal)

bookings.problemDescription: Bike stalled suddenly at traffic light, neutral light on but starter won’t engage.

aiDiagnosis.problemTitle: Loose Clutch Switch / Side-Stand Sensor Interlock
safeChecks: Ensure bike is in neutral and side stand completely raised.

bookings.mechanicDiagnosisNotes: Corroded side stand sensor switch causing ECU to trigger safety cut-off.
bookings.workPerformed: Cleaned side stand sensor terminal, lubricated switch spring, replaced 15A mini blade fuse.

reviews.comment: Rajesh reached Khar in under 12 minutes! Diagnosed the bike sensor issue instantly without unnecessary part replacement. True lifesaver!
Irfan Khan was extremely knowledgeable. My XUV700 had an overheating scare on the flyover. He fixed the clamp and checked the full cooling loop.
Delivered fuel within 15 minutes of my breakdown. Friendly, polite, and completely honest billing.
Bleeding brakes on the street is tough work. Karan brought a full van workshop and had my Honda City safe to drive in under an hour.
